title: the Finnish mythos
audit_comment: THE FINNISH MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round ten, print pp. 57-62: twenty beings (Vainamoinen, Ahto, the Water Dwarf, Ilmarinen, Hiisi, Ilmatar, Kiputytto, Lemminkainen, Kullervo, Tiera, Louhi, Loviatar, Mielikki, the Son of Pohjola, Surma, Tuonetar, Tuoni, Ukko, Untamo, the Air Maiden), the Kalevala doctrine, and the three magic items (the Great Tree, the Magic Wool, the Rake of Iron). Zero registry defs touched; the floor holds at 995. The adjudications: the KULLERVO TIERA FOLD SWAP (the Termux psm fold interleaved the two stat blocks; the geometry columns plus the clean tsv columns plus the prose settled the swap), the Lemminkainen MOVE 12 (the geometry word against the Termux full-text 15), the Louhi HP 110 (the 81px token too narrow for four glyphs), the Mielikki class I pipe (8px), the Tuonetar CH minus 6 (both voices), the Hiisi W:10 and Kullervo W:6 (both voices agree on the odd prints), the foot-mark size decodes (Lemminkainen 6 foot 2, Kullervo 6 foot 1, Tiera 5 foot 4, Mielikki 5 foot 1), the triple-slash moves of Ahto 18/24/24 and Tuoni 18/18/48, and the flagged cells: the Tuonetar fear radius 30 feet (djvu feet against tsv inches), the strength brackets (the Water Dwarf 18(37), Lemminkainen 18(09), the Son of Pohjola 18(00)), and the Loviatar 16(0,+1) bracket.

banner.title: the Finnish mythos - the D&DG walk round ten, print pp. 57-62: twenty beings from Vainamoinen the greatest hero and minstrel of the Kalevala to the Air Maiden of Ukko, the six heroes (Vainamoinen, Ilmarinen, Lemminkainen, Kullervo, Tiera, the Son of Pohjola), the two servants (the Water Dwarf of Ahto, the Air Maiden of Ukko), the three magic items of the mythos intro (the Great Tree, the Magic Wool, the Rake of Iron), and the Kalevala doctrine, across seven planes.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 058-063; the second printing); the collation voice: the archive.org 1st-print derivative (deities-demigods-1st-print, djvu.xml word geometry at 600dpi, segs 57-62). The adjudications: the KULLERVO TIERA FOLD SWAP (the Termux full-text interleave gave Kullervo the lawful good ranger block and Tiera the chaotic neutral block; the djvu column geometry, the tsv clean columns and the prose settled Kullervo as the chaotic neutral S:19(+3,+7) I:15 W:6 D:18 C:19 CH:14 fighter-thief-bard and Tiera as the lawful good S:17(+1,+1) ranger shield man of Lemminkainen), the Lemminkainen MOVE 12 (the djvu and the tsv word against the Termux full-text 15), the Louhi HP 110 (the tsv against the djvu 1170 garble; the 81px token too narrow for four glyphs), the Kiputytto attack 1 (the 11px single glyph against the djvu 17), the psionic pipe of Mielikki (the 8px single stroke read as class I), the negative charisma of Tuonetar (both voices print the minus six), the Hiisi W:10 and the Kullervo W:6 (both voices agree on the odd prints), the foot-mark size decodes (Lemminkainen 6 foot 2, Kullervo 6 foot 1, Tiera 5 foot 4, Mielikki 5 foot 1), the triple-slash moves of Ahto 18/24/24 and Tuoni 18/18/48, the Tuonetar fear radius 30 feet (the djvu feet against the tsv inches), and the Surka armor class minus two (the 64px dash-two token against the bare 2 garble).

bools.comment: she is very adept at the creation of poison and sleep potions, which she uses on guests she wants to eliminate

bools.name: klvLoviatarMaidenOfPain
bools.comment: Loviatar is the goddess of hurt, the Maiden of Pain, a demigoddess

bools.name: klvLoviatarColdMaiden
bools.comment: she is described as a beautiful cold maiden, usually dressed in white silks

bools.name: klvLoviatarColdWindSpeaks
bools.comment: when she speaks a cold wind blows

bools.name: klvLoviatarInflictsPain
bools.comment: her main concern is the inflicting of pain

bools.name: klvLoviatarDaggerOfIce
bools.comment: she owns a dagger of ice that makes her immune to all magical spells

bools.name: klvLoviatarPainReflection
bools.comment: when attacked or when magic is used against her, the attacker will once again re-experience the worst pain he or she has ever suffered (no saving throw)

bools.name: klvLoviatarSecondWorstPain
bools.comment: a second attack on the part of that character would result in the second most painful thing hurting him, and so on

bools.name: klvMielikkiMistressOfTheForest
bools.comment: Mielikki is the goddess of nature, the Mistress of the Forest, a lesser goddess

bools.name: klvMielikkiGreenGossamer
bools.comment: the goddess is always dressed in a green gossamer gown, even in the coldest of winters, and is always surrounded with summer songbirds

bools.name: klvMielikkiWatchesRangers
bools.comment: she watches over rangers and all creatures of the forest, especially dryads

bools.name: klvMielikkiWildsCannotHurtHer
bools.comment: no creature that lives in the wilds is able to hurt her, even if controlled

bools.name: klvMielikkiClericalImmune
bools.comment: she is not affected by clerical spells of any type

bools.name: klvMielikkiSummonsWolvesAndHawks
bools.comment: when magic has failed to hurt her enemies, she has been known to summon huge packs of wolves and flights of hawks to attack despoilers of the forest

bools.name: klvSonEvilHero
bools.comment: the Son of Pohjola is an evil hero

bools.name: klvSonLeaderOfPohjola
bools.comment: this son of Louhi was a leader of the people of Pohjola

bools.name: klvSonEnemyOfLemminkainen
bools.comment: he is a savage enemy to Lemminkainen and the other good heroes of Kalevala

bools.name: klvSonWolfObeysEveryCommand
bools.comment: the giant wolf obeys his every command

bools.name: klvSonWolfColdImmune
bools.comment: the giant wolf is immune to cold attacks

bools.name: klvSonWolfFromLouhi
bools.comment: his mother has given him the giant wolf

bools.name: klvSurmaDemigodOfDeath
bools.comment: Surma is the demigod of death

bools.name: klvSurmaClubOnlyHeCanWield
bools.comment: only Surma can wield this weapon

bools.name: klvSurmaChallengesAll
bools.comment: he occasionally travels about the country challenging all he meets to combat

bools.name: klvSurmaKillsRefusersInSleep
bools.comment: if they refuse, he lets them go only to follow them and kill them in their sleep

bools.name: klvSurmaAgingWarrior
bools.comment: he often appears as a slightly aging warrior in leather buckskins and red boots

bools.name: klvTuonetarGoddessOfTheUnderworld
bools.comment: Tuonetar is the goddess of the underworld, a greater goddess, the wife of Tuoni

bools.name: klvTuonetarUglyCrone
bools.comment: she appears to the world as an incredibly ugly old crone

bools.name: klvTuonetarFleeUntilExhaustion
bools.comment: those affected by the fear aura flee until exhaustion sets in

bools.name: klvTuonetarEnemyOfVainamoinen
bools.comment: she is an implacable enemy of Vainamoinen

bools.name: klvTuoniGodOfTheUnderworld
bools.comment: Tuoni is the god of the underworld, a greater god

bools.name: klvTuoniDarkFurs
bools.comment: this god is usually dressed in dark furs

bools.name: klvTuoniDeathAndPrismaticWall
bools.comment: at will he can constantly shape change and cast death and prismatic wall spells

bools.name: klvTuoniDeathCharmImmune
bools.comment: he is immune to all death and charm-type spells

bools.name: klvTuoniVisionOnRaise
bools.comment: the god will always appear as if in a vision when a being who worships the Finnish pantheon is raised from the dead

bools.name: klvTuoniClubOnlyHeCanLift
bools.comment: his club, which only he can lift, always disenchants one randomly determined magic item on the being hit (no saving throw)

bools.name: klvTuoniClericsTakeValuables
bools.comment: his clerics go about the battlefield and aid those near death to reach the land of the dead, sending the near dead off a bit too soon, and take the dead person valuables as recompense

bools.name: klvUkkoSupremeGod
bools.comment: Ukko is the supreme god of the Kalevala, a greater god

bools.name: klvUkkoTheOldMan
bools.comment: Ukko is represented as an old man

bools.name: klvUkkoSupportsGoodHeroes
bools.comment: he is very supportive of all the good heroes in the mythos

bools.name: klvUkkoMagicAttackFirst
bools.comment: while he usually uses a magic attack, when hard pressed in battle he uses the flaming sword

bools.name: klvUkkoSkyMaster
bools.comment: this god is master of the sky and air, and supports the world: he is responsible for all weather and protects all avian life

bools.name: klvUkkoNonintervention
bools.comment: because he is the supreme god he will never directly intervene in worldly affairs unless there is a strong possibility of the world being destroyed by evil, especially chaotics

bools.name: klvUkkoMaidenAdviseThenRescue
bools.comment: the warrior maiden is sent first to advise, then to rescue the imperiled believer

bools.name: klvUkkoMaidensOnlyCertainDeath
bools.comment: these powerful warriors will be sent only when his worshipers face certain death at the hands of demons, devils or very powerful evil characters

bools.name: klvUntamoGodOfSleep
bools.comment: Untamo is the god of sleep and dreams, a lesser god

bools.name: klvUntamoVeryMild
bools.comment: this god is very mild in all of his actions and dislikes being summoned for any reason

bools.name: klvUntamoSleepAuraOnContact
bools.comment: those who have not slept will go to sleep instantly in his presence

bools.name: klvUntamoClubSleep
bools.comment: those that do not make their saving throw vs. spells will fall instantly asleep

bools.name: klvMaidenUkkosWarrior
bools.comment: the Air Maiden is the warrior of Ukko

bools.name: klvMaidenWingedLight
bools.comment: an air maiden appears as a winged human with a sword, garbed in flowing robes, and glowing with a brilliant light

bools.name: klvMaidenOneAtATime
bools.comment: only one air maiden will appear at a time

bools.name: klvMaidenTelepathy
bools.comment: when sent by Ukko, a maiden will first advise the worshiper as to the best course of action, using telepathy

bools.name: klvMaidenVanishesOnDeath
bools.comment: if a maiden is slain, she and all her possessions including the sword will vanish

bools.name: klvMaidenReplacedOnDeath
bools.comment: should an air maiden be slain before her mission is completed, another will immediately appear

bools.name: klvSonStrDoubleZero
bools.comment: the 18(00) strength of the Son of Pohjola is the maximum percentile print

bools.name: klvLoviStrZeroBracket
bools.comment: Loviatar prints the odd S:16(0, +1) bracket: a zero to hit bonus over a +1 damage bonus

bools.name: klvVainaPaladin
bools.comment: Vainamoinen prints a 20th level paladin on the fighter line (the R857 convention: paladins ride the fighter cols)

bools.name: klvIlmaPaladin
bools.comment: Ilmatar prints a 10th level paladin on the fighter line

bools.name: klvUkkoPaladin
bools.comment: Ukko prints a 20th level paladin on the fighter line

bools.name: klvTieraRanger
bools.comment: Tiera prints a 9th level ranger on the fighter line (rides the fighter cols, the bool carries the ranger word)

bools.name: klvMielRanger
bools.comment: Mielikki prints a 10th level ranger on the fighter line

bools.name: klvSurmaRanger
bools.comment: Surma prints a 15th level ranger on the fighter line

bools.name: klvAhtoInEachMagUser
bools.comment: Ahto prints the 15th level in each magic-user/illusionist pair

bools.name: klvIlmatarInEachCleric
bools.comment: Ilmatar prints the 13th level in each cleric/druid pair

bools.name: klvKiputyttoInEachBoth
bools.comment: Kiputytto prints the in-each pair twice: 14th cleric/druid and 15th magic-user/illusionist

bools.name: klvLouhiInEachCleric
bools.comment: Louhi prints the 10th level in each cleric/druid pair

bools.name: klvLoviatarInEachCleric
bools.comment: Loviatar prints the 12th level in each cleric/druid pair

bools.name: klvMielikkiInEachBoth
bools.comment: Mielikki prints the in-each pair twice: 14th cleric/druid and 12th magic-user/illusionist

bools.name: klvSurmaInEachBoth
bools.comment: Surma prints the in-each pair twice: 14th cleric/druid and 12th magic-user/illusionist, both harming spells only

bools.name: klvTuonetarInEachMagUser
bools.comment: Tuonetar prints the 20th level in each magic-user/illusionist pair

bools.name: klvTuoniInEachMagUser
bools.comment: Tuoni prints the 15th level in each magic-user/illusionist pair

bools.name: klvIlmarinenInEachMagUser
bools.comment: Ilmarinen prints the 9th level in each magic-user/illusionist pair

bools.name: klvKullervoInEachMagUser
bools.comment: Kullervo prints the 8th level in each magic-user/illusionist pair

bools.name: klvTieraInEachMagUser
bools.comment: Tiera prints the 8th level in each magic-user/illusionist pair

bools.name: klvHiisiInEachCleric
bools.comment: Hiisi prints single class lines (15th level cleric and 15th level illusionist over a Nil magic-user), not the in-each pair

tables.name: the combat grid
col_comments: The armor class cells (Vainamoinen -4, Kullervo 1, Louhi 8 the worst, the Air Maiden 5)
The range ceiling cells (0 = a single printed armor class; all twenty read single this round)
The hit point cells (Ukko 400 the supreme, down to 66 per Tiera; Louhi the 110 decode against the djvu 1170 garble)
The primary move cells (-1 = the printed Infinite of Mielikki and Ukko, the R854 convention; Lemminkainen the 12 catch)
The secondary move cells (the printed slash ceilings; Ahto the 18/24/24 and Tuoni the 18/18/48 triple prints)
The attack count cells (the 1s of Ilmatar, Kiputytto, Louhi, Loviatar and Tuonetar; Vainamoinen through Ukko the 2s)
The attack alternative cells (the 3/2 slashes of Ahto, Tiera, Mielikki, the Son of Pohjola and Untamo)
The magic resistance cells (0 = the printed Standard of the seven hero and servant rows; Ahto the 50 otherwise)
The size cells in inches (the foot-mark decodes: Lemminkainen 6 foot 2, Kullervo 6 foot 1, Tiera 5 foot 4, Mielikki 5 foot 1; Tuoni the L 10 foot)

tables.name: the class grid
col_comments: The cleric level cells (Tuoni 20th, Ukko 20th, Hiisi 15th; the in-each pairs of Ilmatar, Kiputytto, Louhi, Loviatar, Mielikki and Surma)
The druid level cells (the in-each pairs; Ilmarinen, Lemminkainen and the Son of Pohjola the single druid prints)
The fighter level floor cells (the paladins Vainamoinen, Ilmatar and Ukko ride the fighter cols; Kullervo 19th, Lemminkainen 18th)
The fighter level ceiling cells (single printed levels read floor = ceiling)
The ranger level cells (0 = no separate ranger line this round; Tiera, Mielikki and Surma print the ranger on the fighter line and ride the bools)
The magic-user level cells (Ukko 25th, Ilmatar 20th, Tuonetar 20th in each; Hiisi, the Son of Pohjola and Untamo print Nil magic-users)
The illusionist level cells (Untamo 25th, Set-style Nil MU pairs; the in-each pairs of Ahto, Ilmarinen, Kiputytto, Kullervo, Mielikki, Surma, Tuonetar and Tuoni)
The thief level cells (Kullervo the 10th level thief, Tiera-style zero elsewhere)
The assassin level cells (Hiisi 15th, Loviatar 10th, Surma 15th, the Son of Pohjola 8th)
The monk level cells (all Nil this round)
The bard level cells (the all-heroes-are-bards doctrine: Vainamoinen 23rd, thirteen printed bard levels total)

tables.name: the ability grid
col_comments: The strength cells (the FOLD SWAP catch: Kullervo the S:19(+3,+7) line the Termux full text gave to Tiera; Tiera the S:17(+1,+1))
The parenthesized strength to-hit bonus cells (0 = no printed bracket; Loviatar the printed zero over the +1 damage)
The parenthesized strength damage bonus cells (the +14s of Surma, Tuoni and Ukko; the +12s of Ahto and Hiisi)
The intelligence cells (Untamo 25th-season I:25, Ukko I:24, the Air Maiden and Kiputytto the 19s)
The wisdom cells (Hiisi the W:10 and Kullervo the W:6 - both voices agree on the odd prints; Mielikki W:25)
The dexterity cells (Vainamoinen D:24, Ahto D:22; Loviatar D:16 the lowest)
The constitution cells (Tuonetar C:25, Ukko C:25; Louhi C:19 over the S:8)
The charisma cells (Tuonetar the negative six print; Kiputytto CH:6, Louhi CH:7, the Water Dwarf CH:7)
The psionic score cells (0 = every being reads the R849 class table this round; no point scores printed)

tables.name: the roster grid
col_comments: The roster ordinal cells (the print order, Vainamoinen through the Air Maiden)
The print page cells (57-62, the folio offset PRINT = PDF - 1)
The alignment cells (0 LG, 1 NG, 4 N, 5 CN the Kullervo and Tuoni evil-tendency prints, 6 LE, 7 NE, 8 CE - the R852 code scheme)
The rank cells (0 lesser, 1 greater, 2 demigod, 3 servant - the Water Dwarf and the Air Maiden, 4 hero - the six Kalevala heroes)
The psionic class cells (Ahto IV, Tuonetar II, Mielikki the 8px pipe read as class I, Hiisi, Loviatar, Surma and Ukko VI)
The plane cells (0 = none printed for the heroes and servants; 1 Prime Material, 2 Elemental Water, 3 Tarterus, 4 Gehenna, 5 Pandemonium, 6 Twin Paradises, 7 Concordant Opposition)
The fixed-damage flags (1 = the printed DAMAGE/ATTACK cell is numeric damage; 0 = the by-weapon rows)
The in-each flags (the printed Nth level in each cells, both the cleric/druid and magic-user/illusionist pairs)
The Pohjola-enmity flags (the printed enemy lines: Kullervo the doomed foil, Louhi, the Son of Pohjola, Tuonetar the implacable enemy of Vainamoinen)
